# Test fixture provenance

`Amiri-Arabic.woff2` is a genuine Google Fonts-served Arabic subset of Amiri,
retrieved from https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/amiri/v30/J7aRnpd8CGxBHpUrtLMA7w.woff2
on 2026-09-30. Source: Google's CSS API for Amiri regular.

License: SIL Open Font License, retained in `Amiri-OFL.txt`.
This binary fixture prevents relying on a WOFF2 encoder to test a WOFF2 decoder.

The app logo uses the outline of U+062D from bundled Tajawal Bold;
the original font's OFL license remains in `public/fonts/tajawal/OFL.txt`.
